title: Rebrand website name from Veda Botanics to Nature Glow

requirements.summary: Replace all occurrences of 'Veda Botanics' with 'Nature Glow' in the HTML shell (frontend/index.html), including the page <title> tag and any meta tags.
acceptanceCriteria: The browser tab title reads 'Nature Glow' instead of 'Veda Botanics'
No instance of 'Veda Botanics' remains in index.html

file_operations.description: Replace 'Veda Botanics' with 'Nature Glow' in the <title> tag and any other occurrences in the HTML document head or body.

requirements.summary: Replace all occurrences of 'Veda Botanics' with 'Nature Glow' in the Navbar component (frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx), including the logo text and any aria-labels or alt text referencing the brand name.
acceptanceCriteria: The navbar logo/brand text displays 'Nature Glow'
No instance of 'Veda Botanics' remains in the Navbar component

file_operations.description: Replace all text strings 'Veda Botanics' with 'Nature Glow' in the logo text, aria-labels, and any other brand name references within the Navbar component.

requirements.summary: Replace all occurrences of 'Veda Botanics' with 'Nature Glow' in the Footer component (frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx), including the brand name, tagline, and any copyright text.
acceptanceCriteria: The footer displays 'Nature Glow' as the brand name
No instance of 'Veda Botanics' remains in the Footer component

file_operations.description: Replace all text strings 'Veda Botanics' with 'Nature Glow' in the brand name display, tagline, copyright text, and any other brand references within the Footer component.

requirements.summary: Replace all occurrences of 'Veda Botanics' with 'Nature Glow' on the Home page (frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx), including the hero section heading, subheadings, and any other brand name references so the name is prominently visible on the homepage.
acceptanceCriteria: The homepage hero section prominently displays 'Nature Glow'
No instance of 'Veda Botanics' remains on the Home page
The brand name 'Nature Glow' is visible without scrolling on the homepage

file_operations.description: Replace all text strings 'Veda Botanics' with 'Nature Glow' in the hero section heading, subheadings, and any other brand name references throughout the Home page component.

requirements.summary: Replace all occurrences of 'Veda Botanics' with 'Nature Glow' in the MobileNavDrawer component (frontend/src/components/MobileNavDrawer.tsx) and AdminLayout component (frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayout.tsx), including any brand name references in the admin sidebar.
acceptanceCriteria: The mobile nav drawer shows 'Nature Glow' wherever the brand name appears
The admin sidebar/layout shows 'Nature Glow' wherever the brand name appears
No instance of 'Veda Botanics' remains in these components

file_operations.description: Replace all text strings 'Veda Botanics' with 'Nature Glow' in any brand name references within the mobile navigation drawer component.
Replace all text strings 'Veda Botanics' with 'Nature Glow' in the admin sidebar header, branding elements, and any other brand name references within the AdminLayout component.

requirements.summary: Search all remaining frontend source files (pages, components, hooks, utils, CSS files) for any remaining string 'Veda Botanics' and replace with 'Nature Glow' to ensure a complete rebrand.
acceptanceCriteria: No instance of 'Veda Botanics' exists anywhere in the frontend source code
All user-facing text that previously said 'Veda Botanics' now says 'Nature Glow'
